RootMC: This would work best as a small server-side plugin, not a required client mod. Players could join normally while the plugin listens for mob deaths and awards a matching head when configured rules are met. **How it could be built** • A config table would define each supported mob, base drop chance, required kill type, and optional Looting bonus. Common mobs should stay rare; bosses and special variants should have separate rates. • Heads would be normal player-head items using the correct texture, a clear name, and persistent metadata identifying the mob and plugin version. That lets admins distinguish legitimate drops from renamed items. • Direct player kills would qualify by default. Spawners, entity cramming, environmental damage, pets, and automated farms should be excluded or heavily reduced. Per-player cooldowns and unusual-drop logging would limit farming and expose abuse. • Heads should begin as cosmetic collectibles: display, trade, collect, or use in events. No combat or economy advantage should be added until actual supply and player behavior are understood. • Admin tools should reload rates, inspect a head, grant test items, and show recent drops. Rates and messages should remain configurable so balancing does not require rebuilding the plugin. Player heads should be a separate, opt-in phase. Valid drops could require genuine PvP, reject repeated kills of the same player during a cooldown, and require both players to enable the feature. This would reduce harassment and boosting. Community input should decide the final rules: Which mobs should launch first? Should heads be tradeable or collection-only? Should player heads be opt-in, enabled for all valid PvP, or omitted? Please add concerns, preferred rates, and ideas here before the design is finalized.
